title: Trespass and Unauthorised Access to Private Properties and Restricted Areas
what_it_is: Trespass and Unauthorised Access to Private Properties and Restricted Areas

sections.label: Trespass cases and arrests
sections.summary: Police report about 580 trespass cases yearly, about 700 arrests yearly, and about 12% of those arrested are youths under 16.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Over the past five years, an average of about 580 cases of trespass were reported to the Police annually.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Of these, an average of 30 cases each year involved acts which caused some damage to properties, that is, mischief and vandalism.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Police do not track trespass cases by whether they involve death and injuries.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Each year, over the past five years, there was an average of about 700 persons arrested for trespassing and about 12% were youths under the age of 16 years old.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Police's experience suggests that cases of trespass committed by youths were often due to peer influence or a desire to seek thrill in their free time.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Individuals may also have trespassed into private land and state land for various other reasons, including illicit activities, such as vice, or less malicious reasons, such as to access fishing sites at the beaches or to pick durians.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Where appropriate, Police work with stakeholders to enhance the security of sites to prevent and deter trespass.

sections.label: Security-sensitive location reviews
sections.summary: The Home Team reviews security measures at security-sensitive locations with owners, including threats from unmanned aircraft prohibited without a permit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: The Home Team works together with owners of security-sensitive locations to regularly review their adequacy of security measures based on the prevailing threat assessment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: This includes threats from unmanned aircraft which are prohibited from flying over security-sensitive locations without a permit under the Air Navigation Act.
